caption: The drawing depicts a round, reddish-brown ceramic bowl shown from a top-down perspective in the center, with a cross-sectional profile of the bowl displayed on both the left and right sides. The bowl has a slightly darker, burnished appearance with some variations in the red tones, and it features a decorative pattern on the interior composed of wavy and looping yellow lines. The rim is marked with a finely dotted or dashed border. The cross-sectional profiles on either side of the main bowl show the thickness and curvature of the ceramic from two different views, one with an outline in pale pink and orange and the other in reddish-brown hues reflecting the bowl’s coloration. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, providing contrast to the object. The artist's signature "W. Weber" appears in small text near the lower left corner.
title: Pie Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
